signature.name: VTask.lift
signature.type: {p : ℕ} -> {R : Type u_1} -> [CommRing R] -> [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] -> {S : Type u_2} -> [Semiring S] -> (f : (k : ℕ) → S →+* TruncatedWittVector p k R) -> (f_compat : ∀ (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (hk : k₁ ≤ k₂), (TruncatedWittVector.truncate hk).comp (f k₂) = f k₁) -> S →+* WittVector p R

conventions.statement: In practice the compatibility proof `f_compat` is passed as an explicit argument but the first (unnamed) slot in `lift` is conventionally written as `_` in the library, letting Lean infer `p`; only `f_compat` needs to be supplied explicitly.

facts.statement: ∀ {p : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {S : Type*} [Semiring S] (f : (k : ℕ) → S →+* TruncatedWittVector p k R) (f_compat : ∀ (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (hk : k₁ ≤ k₂), (TruncatedWittVector.truncate hk).comp (f k₂) = f k₁) (n : ℕ) (s : S), WittVector.truncate n (VTask.lift f f_compat s) = f n s
